column1: # Nothing here comes from a real log. Sensitive values are FAKE-* markers, plus
# 0900-000-00x numbers because the phone rule only matches digits and fakecredential*
# because a word that is all lowercase is what the next-field check has to tell apart.
# Columns are tab separated, the payload is the raw logfmt tail, verbatim:
#   id     case id, also the prefix of every generated run_id
#   group  safe means every generated line must come out byte-identical
#   scope  both     logfmt tail, Trading (rule and msg position matrix) and general
#          raw      Trading only, whole lines: @T@ is the timestamp, <NL> a physical newline
#   marks  comma-separated values that must not survive the scrub, - for none
#   keep   text that must survive, - for none

column6: err="request failed: Authorization: Bearer FAKE-CREDENTIAL-0008 rejected"
mutations=[[[[[FAKE-ACCOUNT-0315A FAKE-ACCOUNT-0315B] FAKE-ACCOUNT-0315C] FAKE-ACCOUNT-0315D] FAKE-ACCOUNT-0315E] FAKE-ACCOUNT-0315F]
err="bad token: " reason="x y" note="z w"
time=@T@ level=ERROR err="bad token: 'x" msg=rv_generic_failure detail="it's fine"

time=@T@ level=ERROR msg=coordinator_fence_stalled err="request dump follows<NL>Authorization: Bearer FAKE-CREDENTIAL-0601<NL>token="FAKE-CREDENTIAL-0602A FAKE-CREDENTIAL-0602B"<NL>order_id=FAKE-ORDER-0603<NL>end of dump"
authorization_required=true cookie_count=2 password_age_days=30 signature_version=2 secret_rotation_days=30 tokenizer=x
